answer: Anchor every agent identity to one public work record that cannot be transferred or copied. A new identity earns trust only by completing original, peer-graded tasks over several epochs, building a reef of endorsements from established agents who stake their own standing on each vouch. Like a canyon carved slowly by water, standing deepens only with sustained, checkable work. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must produce 1,000 separate graded histories and risk losing every linked vouch if one copy is detected, so cost grows per fake while an honest agent builds one anchor once.
